unknowns.discrete: A_phi in continuous quadratic Lagrange P2

weak_form_without_common_2pi.rhs: integral_Omega J_free_phi*v dr dz + integral_Omega nu*(Br_z*partial_r(v)-Br_r*partial_z(v)) dr dz + integral_sheet K_phi*v ds
weak_form_without_common_2pi.test_space: v=r*N_i, where N_i is P2 and axis N_i DOFs are essential zero

interfaces.essential: psi is single-valued because the P2 space is conforming
interfaces.natural: normal component of (nu/r)*grad(psi)-(nu*Br_z,-nu*Br_r) is continuous when K_free_phi=0
interfaces.maxwell: equivalent to n dot (B_plus-B_minus)=0 and tangential H continuity
interfaces.mesh_rule: every linear material boundary is a union of complete triangle edges

energy_action.note: equality applies for homogeneous essential data; manufactured nonzero-Dirichlet tests include boundary work

qois.trace_integration: piecewise P2 Gauss integration split at every triangle crossing
qois.axis_metric: weighted quadratic patch recovery from adjacent axis-edge traces; diagnostic only

adaptivity.estimator: h_K^2*integral_K residual^2 + sum_edges h_e*integral_edge jump(normal flux)^2 ds
adaptivity.edge_quadrature: three-point Gauss; a constant jump contributes edge_length^2*jump^2
adaptivity.qoi_proxy: exponentially localized bore/window weighting of residual-plus-jump action
adaptivity.marking: union of separate deterministic residual, normal-flux-jump, and QoI-proxy Dorfler bulk sets with theta=0.5
adaptivity.refinement: nested conforming longest-edge midpoint bisection with red and parent-level adjacent-size gradation closure
adaptivity.acceptance: two successive volume-QoI changes below 1 percent and stable positive observed order from actual local h

resource_policy.allocation_components: COO keys, sort workspace, unique masks/keys, CSR upper bound, mesh/solver temporaries, checkpoint parse/decompression/serialization buffers
resource_policy.recheck: before every heavy mesh, solve, assembly, artifact, checkpoint, replay, validation and publication phase
resource_policy.startup_low_ram_status: typed ResourceBlockedError with explicit NOT_EVALUATED reason
resource_policy.execution: explicit opt-in and exactly one design at a time

robin_domain_expansion.bound_grid_validation: finite positive local h and finite nested extents recomputed from complete checkpoint grids

assembly.sparse_construction: preallocated topology COO key pass followed by direct numerical CSR pass
assembly.adaptive_initial_guess: linear-work element_parent_ids P2 basis prolongation without global point location

acceptance_authority.level_evidence: ordered hash-addressed metadata plus compressed binary mesh/topology/problem/solver/solution sidecars
acceptance_authority.resource_dimensions: derived from ZIP central directory and bounded NPY headers before allocation; anchors must match
acceptance_authority.chain_identity: artifact schema/classification, design, geometry, magnetics, config, code, problem, parent and final run/mesh
acceptance_authority.bound_identity_replay: direct equality against top-level chain authority for every adaptive and domain checkpoint
acceptance_authority.recomputed: true residual, QoIs, local h, orders, changes, domain status and gates
